summary: Veraxa Biotech AG filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, attaching a July 29, 2026 press release updating its patent portfolio. The company announced first patent applications for BiTAC-TCE and BiTAC-ADC platforms, cleared opposition periods on auxiliary patents, and now holds over 50 granted owned or exclusively licensed patents across 26 families in 14 countries, with protection expected through at least 2047. This is routine IP development disclosure, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic change, or deal terms were stated.
